header.shortDesc: Prevent cavities, remove 40% more plaque with patented expanding floss technology, and support a healthy oral microbiome with SuperMouth’s fluoride dental floss. Dentist-formulated with fluoride, hydroxyapatite (nano-hydroxyapatite), vitamins D3 & K2, prebiotics, and safe, clean ingredients, it’s free from forever chemicals (PFAS) and petroleum-based waxes. Delicious flavors—chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, mint—for kids and adults.
header.superHtml:
You wouldn’t brush your teeth without toothpaste, so why floss without it? Our Hydroxamin®* Floss is packed with the same essential ingredients as our advanced toothpaste, including nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3, K2, and fluoride, to offer a complete oral care solution. Featuring patented expanding technology, this floss removes over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** while being gentle on gums and easy to use. Infused with our unique blend of Hydroxamin® and fluoride, it effectively reaches difficult areas, helping to strengthen enamel, prevent cavities, and promote overall oral health. Available in mouth-watering flavors like mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry, this dentist-formulated floss offers a superior cleaning experience, free from harsh chemicals commonly found in conventional products.

  • Infused with Hydroxamin and Fluoride: Contains nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3, K2, and fluoride to strengthen enamel and reduce cavities.
  • Patented Expanding Technology: Removes over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** for a deeper clean.
  • No Harsh Chemicals: Free from PFAS/PTFE (Teflon®)/PFOA/BPA, petroleum-based products (such as microcrystalline wax), artificial flavors, or colors.
  • Supports Oral Health: Removes plaque and food particles from between teeth to help reduce the risk of tooth decay.
  • Delicious Flavors: Available in mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.
  • Dentist-Formulated & Approved: Developed and approved by leading dentists for an effective and safe flossing experience.

* contains nano-hydroxyapatite material, vitamins K2 and D3

** Genoa University clinical randomized controlled trial.

*** All SuperMouth products rank a 1 on the EWG scale.

items.title: BEST MANUAL FLOSSES FOR ORAL HYGIENE
items.quote: ““Ideally, your floss [should have] key toothpaste ingredients in it,” Hoss says. “That's actually where most of the cavities occur — between the teeth.” If your floss doesn’t have ingredients built in to care for your teeth, Hoss says you can dip your floss in your toothpaste too. This SuperMouth floss is free from harsh chemicals, artificial colors and flavors. It’s also formulated with nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 and K2, plus fluoride to strengthen teeth. Or you can grab a fluoride-free version, but they are all available in Mint, Chocolate, Strawberry and Vanilla flavors.”
